codeReview.summary: Fix correctly addresses the blocking issue from prior review. The compaction_strategy field is now properly wired from AgentHarnessConfig into AgentCompactionSettings. AgentHarnessConfig struct is properly defined with serde defaults, and with_harness_config() builder method correctly applies trajectory, compaction, and verification settings based on config. The compaction strategy enum mapping (head_tail, age_based, budget_based) is correctly implemented.

issues.description: AgeBased strategy uses hardcoded max_age_days=7 and BudgetBased uses hardcoded max_tokens=16000. These values are not configurable via AgentHarnessConfig. This appears intentional since TOML config only exposes head_tail options, but could be confusing if users expect all strategies to be configurable.

AgentCompactionSettings stores head_count and tail_count both in the CompactionStrategy::HeadTail variant AND as separate struct fields. This is redundant but not incorrect - the strategy is used by compact_conversation while separate fields could theoretically be used for other purposes. The design could be simplified by removing the redundant fields.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The harness module (src/harness/) is not documented in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md module tables. The harness module contains compactor.rs, observability.rs, trajectory.rs, and verifier.rs - all related to agent harness functionality (compaction, verification, trajectory logging). The module tables only show service.rs, http.rs, provider.rs, channel.rs, memory.rs, scheduler.rs, mcp.rs, skills.rs, code_mode.rs, config.rs, skills_commands.rs, mcp_commands.rs.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: CLAUDE.md line 42-57: Core Modules table does not mention harness module. AGENTS.md also does not document the harness module.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The [agent.harness] config section is documented in config/xiaomaolv.example.toml but not in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md configuration section. Compare to [agent.code_mode] which is documented in both the example config and CLAUDE.md.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: config/xiaomaolv.example.toml has [agent.harness] section with comments, but CLAUDE.md configuration section (lines 71+) does not describe agent.harness options.

summary: Task 5 (Configuration Schema) passes code review. The fix (cbd0601) correctly wires compaction_strategy from AgentHarnessConfig to AgentCompactionSettings. The AgentHarnessConfig struct is properly implemented with serde defaults, and with_harness_config() correctly applies harness settings.
